events.title: Trade under a tight liquidity constraint

variants.text:
When lodging is unstable, even a small payment delay puts more pressure on a decision. You choose commission work and a short cycle instead of promising a large purchase for which there is no current buffer.

A cheap room provides shelter, but it does not make working funds unlimited. You plan trades so the next required expense does not depend on one risky sale.

Commission work lets you participate in trade without buying the entire lot in advance. You are paid for completed work rather than receiving free capital or a hidden subsidy.

A narrow barter can solve one concrete need in a trade when both sides understand what is exchanged. It does not become a universal currency or erase the cost of housing or ordinary work.

Merchant creates no separate debt, credit meter, or hidden way to erase existing obligations. Poverty changes the context and caution of a choice, but it is not rewritten by a new career mechanic.

choices.label: Take commission work only
choices.text: Reduce exposure by handling a sale for someone else without creating Merchant-owned credit state.

choices.label: Keep the obligation narrow
choices.text: Record only what is exchanged and when; do not create a new balance subsystem or clear any shared obligation.
